headword: {進行方向|しんこうほうこう}
gloss: direction of travel; direction of movement

definitions.gloss: direction of travel; direction of movement
definitions.explanation: The direction in which something is moving or proceeding. Most commonly used for trains, vehicles, and other forms of transportation. Frequently seen on signs and in announcements.

examples.japanese: {進行方向|しんこうほうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かって→向かう：01186_mukau⟧⟦{右側|みぎがわ}→右側：24189_migigawa⟧です。
examples.english: It's on the right side in the direction of travel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進行方向|しんこうほうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かって→向かう：01186_mukau⟧⟦{座|すわ}りたい→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: I want to sit facing the direction the train is moving.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進行方向|しんこうほうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わり→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧、⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{直撃|ちょくげき}→直撃：13719_chokugeki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた。
examples.english: The typhoon's direction of travel changed, raising the possibility of a direct hit on the Kanto region.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound noun formed from ⟦{進行|しんこう}→進行：03686_shinkou⟧ (progress, movement) + ⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧ (direction). Very common in train travel — passengers often choose seats based on {進行方向|しんこうほうこう} (forward-facing) versus ⟦{逆方向|ぎゃくほうこう}→逆方向：15966_gyakuhoukou⟧ (backward-facing). Also used in weather reports for typhoons and weather fronts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {進行方向|しんこうほうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かって→向かう：01186_mukau⟧ (facing the direction of travel)
- {進行方向|しんこうほうこう}⟦{右側|みぎがわ}→右側：24189_migigawa⟧/⟦{左側|ひだりがわ}→左側：22836_hidarigawa⟧ (right/left side in the direction of travel)
- {進行方向|しんこうほうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ (the direction of travel changes)
- {進行方向|しんこうほうこう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧ (opposite to the direction of travel)
